Date-bound door

When the portal closes, so does the door

The 11/11 workshop is built around a date. Once it passes, a new follower who finds you tomorrow has no low-priced paid step until the next live event, only a $333 course.

Linktree maze

Seven choices, one visitor

Workshop, membership, retreat, podcast, money course, coaching, free track. A new visitor has to work out where to start on their own, and most choose nothing.

Content treadmill

1,660 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next episode. When you step away to lead a retreat, the flow of new people slows down too.

The Lightworkers who love your work but aren't ready for Lightleader or a retreat today have no low-priced, always-on way to say a small yes, so most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

An always-on [$27] Soul Mission Reset, with RICHUALS as the next step and an application for Lightleader

You already run live workshops, so your audience knows how to learn from you. What's missing is one evergreen product, priced well below your $333 course, that anyone can buy on any day: a 5-day audio course built on your three pillars, intuition, subconscious rewiring and nervous system regulation. A small order bump at checkout, your RICHUALS membership as the one-click upsell, and an invitation to apply for Lightleader on the welcome page. Meta ads send new Lightworkers to it every day, and the front-end sales help pay for the ads.

Questions

Before you start

Who is this for?

Lightworkers, coaches and space-holders who know they have a soul mission and want to expand it their way, through intuition, subconscious rewiring and nervous system regulation.

How does it work?

Five days, one guided audio and one short practice a day, plus the Soul Mission Map workbook. You get instant access and keep every audio for life.

Is it a one-off payment?

Yes. The Reset is a one-off payment of [$27]. There is no subscription.

I'm new to this work. Is that okay?

Yes. Each day builds on the one before, so you can start wherever you are.

What happens after I buy?

You'll get an email from Laura with your access, and a welcome page where Day 1 is waiting. At the end of the 5 days, Laura explains how working with her works, so you can choose the support that fits where you are.

Is this therapy or medical advice?

No. It's educational and coaching content, not medical or mental health advice. Experiences vary.

"The same old pattern"

Hook
"If you've journaled, meditated and manifested, and the same old pattern keeps showing up, your mindset isn't the problem." (to camera, natural light, hat on, same feel as your profile photo)

"Intuition or fear?"

Hook
